title: Forward-Facing Near-Infrared Adds Little to Colour for Farm-Machinery Traversability: A Site-Disjoint Evaluation of Sensor-Dependent Spatial Leakage
abstract: arXiv:2609.13265v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Near-infrared (NIR) imaging does not consistently outperform standard color cameras for daytime agricultural traversability once spatial data leakage is eliminated. Prior benchmarks suggesting an NIR advantage used sequence-level splits that permitted spatially autocorrelated imagery into test sets, artificially inflating NIR performance, especially on difficult paddy-boundary segmentation.   When evaluated across strictly held-out recording sites using the AI Hub autonomous driving corpus, none of the four tested configurations (color, NIR, a luminance control, or their fusion) reliably surpasses standard color across any of the five traversability classes. Furthermore, apparent performance gains observed at a single held-out site completely fail to replicate when the held-out site is rotated, demonstrating that the observed benefits were site-specific artifacts rather than generalizable improvements.   Correcting for spatial leakage

translated_title: 前向近红外成像对农业机械可通行性判断在彩色图像基础上几乎无增益：一项针对传感器依赖性空间泄漏的场地分离评估
translated_abstract: 在消除空间数据泄漏后，近红外（NIR）成像在白天农业可通行性任务中并不总是优于标准彩色相机。此前声称近红外具有优势的基准测试采用了序列级的数据划分方式，使空间自相关的图像得以进入测试集，从而人为地夸大了近红外的性能，尤其是在困难的稻田边界分割任务上。当使用AI Hub自动驾驶语料库在严格隔离的采集场地上进行评估时，四种测试配置（彩色、近红外、亮度对照及其融合）中没有任何一种能在五个可通行性类别中可靠地超越标准彩色图像。此外，在单一隔离场地上观察到的表面性能提升，在轮换隔离场地后完全无法复现，这表明观察到的收益是特定场地造成的伪影，而非可泛化的改进。在纠正空间泄漏后……
tldr: 该研究发现，在严格消除空间数据泄漏后，前向近红外成像在白天农业机械可通行性判断中并不比标准彩色相机更优，此前报告的近红外优势实为场地相关的数据泄漏伪影。
en_tdlr: Once spatial data leakage is eliminated, forward-facing near-infrared imaging adds little to color cameras for daytime farm-machinery traversability, as previously observed NIR advantages were site-specific artifacts.
